dek: A New Moon in Scorpio lands Monday, November 9, and the retrogrades end Thursday. Here is how to use the week.

slides.label: Monday
slides.text: The *New Moon in Scorpio* arrives at *2:02 a.m. ET on November 9*, near 17 degrees of Scorpio.

slides.label: The energy
slides.text: Scorpio rules *depth, power, money and the things we keep hidden*. New Moons are for beginnings. Clear out first.

slides.label: Thursday
slides.text: *Mercury and Venus both turn direct on November 13*, ending the fall stretch of retrogrades.

slides.label: What that means
slides.text: Clearer *communication* and timing from Mercury. Easier calls on *love and money* from Venus.

slides.label: The plan
slides.text: *Monday:* write what you are releasing. *Tue and Wed:* finish things. *Thursday:* start. Pitch it, book it, send it.

slides.label: The Den's take
slides.text: *Scorpio:* your year starts now. *Taurus:* clear the air with your partner. *Everyone:* let go Monday, begin Thursday.

caption_instagram:
New Moon in Scorpio: Monday, November 9, at 2:02 a.m. ET. 🌑

Scorpio is the sign of depth, power, money and the things we keep hidden, and New Moons are for fresh starts. Clear out before you start anything new.

Then the big exhale: Mercury and Venus both turn direct on Thursday, November 13, ending the fall stretch of retrogrades. Think clearer conversations, better timing and easier calls on love and money.

The plan: Monday, write down what you are releasing. Tuesday and Wednesday, finish things. Thursday, start.
